tools.name: agent_ask
tools.description: Run an agentic AI turn that may edit the workspace; answers the refreshed change set.

mode.description: How far the agent may act on its own.

resume.description: Prior session id, to continue that conversation.

tools.name: ai_usage_get
tools.description: Read the aggregated AI token and cost use.

tools.name: assistant_ask
tools.description: Ask one read-only AI turn about the repository. The answer names the model that produced it.

contextPaths.description: Repository-relative files to put in context.

kind.description: Engine choice; omitted lets the service choose.

tools.name: assistant_history_get
tools.description: Read the stored assistant conversation for a repository.

tools.name: assistant_history_set
tools.description: Replace the stored assistant conversation for a repository.

messages.description: The full conversation as {role, content} messages.

tools.name: assistant_model_list
tools.description: List the AI models and engines available to the caller.

tools.name: atlas_get
tools.description: Read the service landscape graph.

tools.name: attachment_delete
tools.description: Remove one attachment from a ToDo and answer the refreshed list.

id.description: Run id (a ToDo or an automatic run).

tools.name: attachment_read
tools.description: Read one ToDo attachment's bytes.

id.description: Run id (a ToDo or an automatic run).

tools.name: attachment_upload

filename.description: File name to store it under.

id.description: Run id (a ToDo or an automatic run).

tools.name: axiom_conform
tools.description: Check a record draft against the constitution's own form rules.

tools.name: axiom_create
tools.description: Add a constitution record. Answers a duplicate or a conformance objection instead of writing when one applies.

force.description: Write even though a similar record exists.

section.description: Target category; omitted lets the service classify.

tools.name: axiom_delete
tools.description: Delete one constitution record.

tools.name: axiom_get
tools.description: Read one constitution record with its authorship.

path.description: Record path in the constitution tree.

tools.name: axiom_move
tools.description: Move one constitution record to another category.

tools.name: axiom_optimize
tools.description: Answer a sharpened wording for a record draft without writing it.

section.description: Category the draft is meant for.

tools.name: axiom_tree
tools.description: Read the constitution tree: categories with their records.

tools.name: axiom_update
tools.description: Replace one constitution record's title and text.

tools.name: branch_checkout
tools.description: Switch the workspace to an existing branch.

tools.name: branch_create
tools.description: Create a branch and switch to it.

from.description: Branch to start from; omitted uses the current one.

tools.name: calendar_get
tools.description: Read the due dates and executions on the calendar.

days.description: How many days ahead to include.

kind.description: Narrow to one kind of run.

tools.name: category_move
tools.description: Move a whole constitution category, records included.

tools.name: category_reorder
tools.description: Set the display order of the records inside one category.

order.description: Record ids in the wanted order.

tools.name: change_stage
tools.description: Stage one changed path for the next commit.

tools.name: change_unstage
tools.description: Unstage one path again.

tools.name: comment_create
tools.description: Add a comment to a file, optionally as a reply.

parentId.description: Comment to reply to; omitted starts a thread.

path.description: Repository-relative path the comment belongs to.

tools.name: comment_delete
tools.description: Delete one comment the caller is allowed to remove.

tools.name: comment_list
tools.description: List the comment threads on one file.

path.description: Repository-relative path the thread hangs on.

tools.name: commit_create
tools.description: Commit the staged changes on the current branch.

tools.name: config_get
tools.description: Read the service configuration.

tools.name: config_set
tools.description: Replace the service configuration. It takes effect at once — a smaller capacity lets running executions finish, a larger one starts what waits.
tools.note: The UI deliberately does not write configuration: it is maintained centrally, so this tool is the named caller of the configuration-write route.

automergeWindow.description: How long a delivery may wait for automatic merge, as a duration.

defaultTimeBudget.description: Default time budget per execution, as a duration (for example 3h).

maxConcurrency.description: How many executions may run at once.

tools.name: delivery_list
tools.description: List the deliveries: what was delivered where, in which state.

tools.name: delivery_rollback
tools.description: Reverse one delivery by counter-committing it. History is never rewritten; a conflict becomes a ToDo.

tools.name: execution_active_list
tools.description: List the executions running right now, plus the restart state.

tools.name: execution_list
tools.description: List stored executions (the history), newest first.

kind.description: Narrow to one kind of run.

tools.name: file_diff
tools.description: Read one file's working-tree diff as before/after text.

tools.name: file_read
tools.description: Read one file from the repository workspace.

tools.name: file_write
tools.description: Write file content in the workspace and answer the refreshed change set.

tools.name: github_unlink
tools.description: Remove the caller's GitHub link.

tools.name: mercury_chat
tools.description: Talk to the planning assistant about the constitution and the run plan; it answers with proposed actions.

messages.description: The conversation as {role, content} messages; role is one of: user, assistant.

tools.name: notice_clear
tools.description: Mark every notice as read.

tools.name: notice_dismiss
tools.description: Mark one notice as read.

tools.name: notice_list
tools.description: List the standing notices the service raised about itself.

tools.name: port_list
tools.description: Read the port ledger derived from the observed host state, including double bookings.

tools.name: pr_open
tools.description: Push the current branch and open (or adopt) its pull request into the default branch.

title.description: Pull-request title; omitted uses the branch name.

tools.name: repo_ensure
tools.description: Prepare the caller's workspace for a repository (clone if absent). Idempotent.

tools.name: repo_get
tools.description: Read one repository: file tree, changes, branches and tracking state.

branch.description: Branch to read; omitted reads the checked-out one.

tools.name: repo_list
tools.description: List the repositories the caller may work on.

tools.name: repo_pull
tools.description: Pull the current branch from its remote.

tools.name: repo_push
tools.description: Push the current branch to its remote.

tools.name: repo_reset
tools.description: Discard the development branch of one repository and start it again from the default branch.

tools.name: report_status_get
tools.description: Read which daily reports were sent, to whom, and what failed.

tools.name: run_ai_fill
tools.description: Propose automatic runs for the constitution records that have none. Proposes only; nothing is written.

tools.name: run_ai_finetune
tools.description: Propose a reshaped run plan for the whole constitution. Proposes only; nothing is written.

tools.name: run_cancel
tools.description: Abort one run's live execution. Its transcript and result stay.

id.description: Run id (a ToDo or an automatic run).

tools.name: run_coverage_get
tools.description: Read which constitution records are covered by a run and which are not.

schedule.description: When it runs, as answered by run_get.

tools.description: Delete one run. Its execution results stay readable.

id.description: Run id (a ToDo or an automatic run).

tools.description: Read one run with the axioms it references.

id.description: Run id (a ToDo or an automatic run).

tools.name: run_list
tools.description: List all runs with the axiom titles they reference.

tools.name: run_prompt_get
tools.description: Read the prompt a run would execute with, as it stands now.

mode.description: fill keeps existing runs; replace discards them.

plan.description: The proposal as answered by run_ai_fill or run_ai_finetune.

tools.name: run_result_get
tools.description: Read one execution result document with its per-repository stage array.

id.description: Run id (a ToDo or an automatic run).

tools.name: run_result_list
tools.description: List one run's execution result documents, newest first.

id.description: Run id (a ToDo or an automatic run).

tools.name: run_resume
tools.description: Resume a deferred or blocked execution where it stopped.

id.description: Run id (a ToDo or an automatic run).

tools.description: Restore the run plan from one snapshot. The current plan is snapshotted first.

dueAt.description: Due date as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

kind.description: todo is a one-off task, auto a scheduled run.

schedule.description: When it runs, as answered by run_get.

tuning.description: Per-run time budget and model settings, as answered by run_get.

tools.name: storage_get

tools.name: telemetry_get
tools.description: Read the service's own resource use.

tools.name: user_get
tools.description: Read the calling identity: display name, DevLab access and GitHub-link state.

tools.name: vision_delete
tools.description: Delete one vision asset and answer the refreshed listing.

tools.name: vision_list
tools.description: List the repository's vision assets.

omittedDataSourceOps.subject: init
omittedDataSourceOps.reason: Bootstrap probe of the web surface (liveness plus identity); its substance is user_get.

omittedDataSourceOps.subject: githubAuthorizeUrl
omittedDataSourceOps.reason: Builds the address that starts the browser's GitHub consent flow — an interactive redirect, not a request/response capability.

omittedDataSourceOps.subject: terminalUrl
omittedDataSourceOps.reason: Builds the WebSocket address of a shell session — a bidirectional stream with no request/response shape.

omittedDataSourceOps.subject: events
omittedDataSourceOps.reason: Opens the one live-update stream; MCP carries its own notification channel, so a second stream would be a parallel path.

untooledRoutes.subject: GET /api/health
untooledRoutes.reason: Public liveness probe, deliberately minimal; not a user capability.

untooledRoutes.subject: POST /api/auth/refresh
untooledRoutes.reason: Cookie-session plumbing of the browser surface; an MCP caller authenticates per call.

untooledRoutes.subject: GET /api/github/authorize
untooledRoutes.reason: Starts the browser's GitHub consent flow.

untooledRoutes.subject: GET /api/github/callback
untooledRoutes.reason: Receives the browser's GitHub consent redirect.

untooledRoutes.subject: POST /api/mcp
untooledRoutes.reason: The MCP endpoint itself — a tool for it would be a loop.
